name: 304 Stainless Steel Fire Grate
trademarkNote: Big Green Egg® is a registered trademark of its owner. Tyler Manufacturing is not affiliated with or endorsed by Big Green Egg.
shortDescription: A replacement fire grate laser cut from 1/4" 304 stainless steel, made to outlast the cast iron original that rusts out.
description: ASK JOSH to review: Cast iron fire grates rust and crack over time. This one is laser cut in Nacogdoches, Texas from 1/4" thick 304 stainless steel, so it stands up to heat and weather far longer. Drop-in replacement for the fire grate in an XL Big Green Egg.
